name: autocedar
description: Author Cedar access-control policies from natural-language requirements with human-reviewed targets and symbolic verification (cedar symcc).

interface.longDescription: AutoCedar turns natural-language access-control requirements into Cedar policies. You review small intent atoms (floors, ceilings and workflow slices) in plain English; AutoCedar compiles the approved atoms into a verification target and synthesizes a Cedar policy that cedar symcc proves satisfies it.
defaultPrompt: Turn these access-control requirements into a verified Cedar policy
Verify this Cedar policy against its verification plan
